about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I am an IT and Business Intelligence professional based in South Africa, I worked in the mining industry at Palabora Mining Company.
My work spans data engineering, dashboard design, database architecture, and process automation — always with the goal of turning raw enterprise data into clear, strategic insight.
Outside of my day-to-day role, I continue to build technical depth through certifications and hands-on projects across cloud, data, and automation technologies.
